'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Carulli DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place]]
* '''Username:''' QuickDraw3457
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
